title: Kyndryl and Krungsri advance core banking transformation
summary: Five-year agreement will leverage Kyndryl’s automation, AI and managed services capabilities to accelerate Krungsri’s core banking transformation
body_markdown:
**BANGKOK, September 10, 2026** —[Kyndryl](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) (NYSE: KD), a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, today announced the renewal of its long-standing partnership with[Krungsri (Bank of Ayudhya PCL)](https://www.krungsri.com/) . Under the five-year agreement, Kyndryl will support Krungsri as the bank strengthens the efficiency and resiliency of its IT operations while accelerating its core banking transformation through[Kyndryl Bridge](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/services/platform) , automation, AI-powered operations, Mainframe-as-a-Service capabilities and application modernization services.


As Thailand advances towards a more digital and innovative financial system, Krungsri is modernizing the mission-critical technology environment that supports its core banking operations. As part of its transformation journey, the bank aims to create intelligent, seamless financial experiences integrated into customers’ daily lives. Krungsri is investing in technology and digital capabilities to enhance customer experiences, strengthen trust and drive innovation across its operations in a digital-first world. Kyndryl’s role is to help modernize and transform the technology foundation underpinning Krungsri’s core banking environment, combining managed services, modernization expertise and AI-enabled operations. Through Kyndryl Bridge, the company’s AI-powered open integration platform, the engagement will use automation and AI to reduce manual IT activities, strengthen infrastructure monitoring and optimize batch processing, enabling Krungsri’s broader modernization initiatives.


“The[banking industry](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/industries/banking-and-financial-markets) is being reshaped by a mix of technological progress, changing customer expectations, regulatory shifts, and new financial models,” said Mr. Kenichi Yamato, President and Chief Executive Officer, Krungsri. “Together, these forces are bringing us to a point where traditional approaches must be reassessed and reinvented. To keep pace, we need an IT infrastructure that is resilient, flexible, and scalable. That is where our partnership with Kyndryl comes in. Their deep domain expertise will help us further modernize our IT infrastructure, enabling us to advance our vision while keeping customer-centricity and personalized solutions at the heart of everything we do.”


“Our partnership with Krungsri has grown alongside the bank’s technology ambitions, from strengthening its technology foundation to supporting its broader digital transformation,” said Mr. Kittipong Asawapichayon, Managing Director, Kyndryl Thailand. “By combining our understanding of Krungsri’s environment with[Kyndryl Consult](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/consulting) , Kyndryl Bridge, automation, and AI expertise, we can support the data center infrastructure behind the bank’s core operations, including its nationwide operation network. Our mainframe expertise, global talent pool and agentic AI capabilities enable us to scale support for this transformation.”


Under the renewed partnership, Krungsri will leverage Kyndryl’s managed services capabilities, consulting expertise, and AI-driven operational capabilities across its data center IT environment, including infrastructure supporting more than 4,800 ATMs. Kyndryl will also use agentic AI capabilities to support modernization, operational transformation, and intelligent automation across Krungsri’s technology environment.


Kyndryl will provide a flexible Mainframe-as-a-Service model to supply capacity and operational support for Krungsri’s banking technology transformation. The engagement will use the[Kyndryl Agentic AI Framework](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en/artificial-intelligence/agentic-ai-framework) to help accelerate modernization by orchestrating AI-enabled workflows across Krungsri’s technology environment, supporting activities such as application and infrastructure analysis, operational automation and targeted modernization initiatives. This approach will help reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency and enable Krungsri to advance its transformation priorities while maintaining human oversight.


Building on a longstanding relationship, Kyndryl has supported Krungsri's technology transformation through initiatives including network modernization, cloud adoption, workplace transformation and IT service improvements. The renewed agreement expands that work with infrastructure and mainframe services, as well as AI-enabled capabilities, to help modernize Krungsri’s core banking environment and support its long-term transformation objectives.


From left to right: Pochara Vanaratseath, Head of Information Technology Group, Krungsri; Duangdao Wongpanitkrit, Chief Finance and Strategy Officer, Krungsri; Kenichi Yamato, President and Chief Executive Officer, Krungsri; Kittipong Asawapichayon, Managing Director, Kyndryl Thailand; Andrew Lim, Managing Director, Kyndryl ASEAN and Korea; Kin Man Lee, Director, Strategic Engagement, Kyndryl


**About Krungsri**
Krungsri (Bank of Ayudhya PCL and its business units) is the fifth largest financial group in Thailand in terms of assets, loans, and deposits, and one of Thailand’s six Domestic Systemically Important Banks (DSIBs) with more than 80 years of history in the country. Krungsri is a strategic member of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), Japan’s largest financial group and one of the world’s largest financial organizations. Krungsri provides a comprehensive range of banking, consumer finance, investment, asset management, and other financial products and services to individual consumers, SMEs, and large corporations through 542 domestic branches (502 Banking Branches and 40 Auto Business Branches) and over 34,379 service outlets nationwide. The Krungsri Group is the largest card issuer in Thailand with 10.6 million credit cards, sales finance, and personal loan accounts in its portfolio; a major automobile financing service provider (Krungsri Auto); one of the fastest growing asset management companies (Krungsri Asset Management); and a pioneer in microfinance (Tidlor Holdings Pcl.). For more information, visit[www.krungsri.com](https://www.krungsri.com/) .


**About Kyndryl** Kyndryl (NYSE: KD) is a leading provider of mission-critical enterprise technology services, offering advisory, implementation and managed service capabilities to thousands of customers in more than 60 countries. As the world’s largest IT infrastructure services provider, the company designs, builds, manages and modernizes the complex information systems that the world depends on every day. For more information, visit[www.kyndryl.com](https://www.kyndryl.com/us/en) .
